Lemma 5.16\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0112 ↗ hanlin:ch05-lem-5-13 ↗ hanlin:ch05-thm-5-8 Let $B_{6\sqrt n}\subset \Omega $ with $\Omega $ bounded, and suppose $u\in S^+(\lambda ,\Lambda ,f)$ in $B_{6\sqrt n}$ with $f\in C(B_{6\sqrt n})$. There are $\sigma \in (0,1)$, $\delta _0>0$, and $M>1$, depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda $, such that \[ \| f\| _{L^n(B_{6\sqrt n})}\leq \delta _0,\qquad \Gm {1}{u,\Omega }\cap Q_3\neq \emptyset \] implies $|\Gm {M}{u,\Omega }\cap Q_1|\geq 1-\sigma $.

Proof

\sketch Combine the barrier construction of Lemma 2 with Theorem 1 to enlarge the lower contact set.
